dataset: Suggestions — proposed improvements and the review/decision process
note: Each suggestion is a proposal only. Nothing is implemented before a reviewer picks the best path for each decision. The suggested review workflow: (1) read the question/gap that motivates the suggestion, (2) compare options, (3) record the chosen path, (4) implement only after selection.

rows.suggestion: Phase strategy development: Phase 1 single bets (spread/total/moneyline), Phase 2 player props, Phase 3 parlay combinations.
rows.rationale: Market efficiency rises with liquidity: spreads are the most efficient and the best test of a model's true edge; props are the least efficient and offer the most edge potential but require more signal infrastructure. Sequencing builds the validation pipeline on the easiest market first.
rows.expected_impact: High — establishes a proven edge on the most efficient market before expanding into harder markets.
rows.decision_needed: Confirm the phase order and entry criteria for each phase.

rows.suggestion: Acquire machine-readable official lines via licensed book APIs or an official odds feed (e.g., a sportsbook data API with book-level keys), replacing the currently blank/flagged lines table.
rows.rationale: No strategy can compute edge without real, verified market prices. Official feeds are the only compliant source; the current aggregator snapshot is non-official and cannot be used to fill values.
rows.expected_impact: High — unblocks the entire lines/strategy pipeline.
rows.decision_needed: Choose the feed provider and confirm legality in the operating jurisdiction.

rows.suggestion: Codify validation gates numerically: minimum edge threshold, minimum sample size, walk-forward holdout, and a CLV significance test before any strategy earns leaderboard eligibility.
rows.rationale: Every strategy must pass validation gates; thresholds must be explicit and fixed in advance to prevent post-hoc tuning (a form of luck).
rows.expected_impact: High — makes strategy qualification objective and reproducible.
rows.decision_needed: Set the numeric thresholds (edge %, sample size, significance level).

rows.suggestion: Compute and store a correlation matrix across signal families (team strength, opponent adjustment, injury-adjusted, situational, market-implied) and require multi-leg strategies to price legs jointly.
rows.rationale: Parlays and prop combos assume independent legs; correlated legs require joint distributions. Storing correlation values makes the model honest about combined-bet probability.
rows.expected_impact: High — prevents overstated edges in parlay/prop-combo strategies.
rows.decision_needed: Approve the correlation families and the minimum correlation threshold that blocks naive multiplication.

rows.suggestion: Add a verifiable depth-order data source (or an NFL.com-verified roster-status pipeline) and score starter-vs-backup substitution impact per position group for offense and defense.
rows.rationale: Depth-chart order is not machine-verifiable from NFL.com (depth page 404s); only roster status is. Adjusted Games Lost (AGL) methodology shows how to weight starters over bench to quantify injury impact.
rows.expected_impact: High — directly implements the required 2nd/3rd/4th-string deficiency tracking.
rows.decision_needed: Select the depth-order source and the substitution-impact scoring method.

rows.suggestion: Make CLV (closing line value) the primary skill metric and layer luck-adjusted efficiency metrics (INT/drop/fumble luck adjustments) into all signal computation.
rows.rationale: CLV measures price-finding skill independent of outcome variance; luck-adjusted efficiency strips luck from underlying performance. This directly implements 'remove luck from the equation.'
rows.expected_impact: High — strategies are judged on skill, not variance.
rows.decision_needed: Confirm CLV as the primary skill metric and set the significance criterion.

rows.suggestion: Score the leaderboard on luck-adjusted metrics (edge/CLV, risk-adjusted return) with minimum-bet requirements and walk-forward periods; publish reward tiers for top performers.
rows.rationale: Rewarding raw profit rewards luck and risk; luck-adjusted scoring aligns rewards with the project's skill-based requirement.
rows.decision_needed: Confirm reward tiers, minimum bets, and season length.

rows.suggestion: Build a versioned signal library: each signal (EPA, DVOA, success rate, SOS, injury-adjusted, market-implied) is versioned with its validation status and out-of-sample weight.
rows.rationale: Signal versions prevent silent changes that corrupt long-run results; out-of-sample weights stop overfitting.
rows.decision_needed: Approve the versioning scheme and weight-update rules.

rows.suggestion: Add a dashboard summary panel on the landing page: verified-data counts, unverified/flagged counts, open decisions, and a quick link to each category.
rows.rationale: A clean dashboard helps a reviewer see at a glance what is verified, what needs review, and what decisions are open.
rows.expected_impact: Medium — improves decision-making speed and transparency.
rows.decision_needed: Confirm which summary metrics to surface.

rows.suggestion: Add interactive filters to data tables (team, position, status, week) and a global search across pages.
rows.rationale: With 345 injury rows and growing datasets, filtering is essential for usability.

rows.suggestion: Add a 'Decision Log' section that records each review decision (chosen option, date, rationale, source links) alongside the Questions and Suggestions pages.
rows.rationale: The user requires that someone reviews suggestions and chooses the best path before implementing; a decision log makes that process auditable.
rows.expected_impact: Medium — makes the review process traceable.
rows.decision_needed: Confirm the decision-log fields and reviewer.

rows.suggestion: Automate weekly refresh of standings and injury reports, and continuous refresh of lines once a verified feed exists; show 'last verified' timestamps on every table.
rows.rationale: Freshness determines signal quality; timestamps keep verification honest.
rows.expected_impact: Medium — keeps the site's verified data current.
rows.decision_needed: Confirm refresh schedule and automation host.
